terms.title: Terms & Conditions
terms.intro: These Terms govern your use of the Zaltrix mobile application. By creating an account you agree to them in full.
terms.s1Body: You are responsible for the accuracy of the information you provide and for keeping your credentials, PIN and registered biometrics confidential. Notify us immediately if you believe your account has been accessed without your permission.
terms.s2Body: You agree not to misuse the service, attempt to gain unauthorised access to any part of it, reverse engineer the application, or use it in any way that breaches applicable law.
terms.s3Body: Biometric authentication is performed entirely on your device. Zaltrix never receives, transmits or stores your fingerprint or face data. Your PIN is stored in encrypted device keystore and is never sent to our servers.
terms.s4Body: We process personal data as described in our Privacy Policy. You may request export or deletion of your data at any time from within the application or by contacting support.
terms.s5Body: With your permission we may send push notifications about product updates, security events and reminders. You can withdraw this permission at any time from Settings or your device settings.
terms.s6Body: We aim to keep the service available at all times but do not guarantee uninterrupted access. Features may be added, changed or removed as the product evolves.
terms.s7Body: You may stop using the service and delete your account at any time. We may suspend accounts that breach these Terms, with notice where reasonably possible.
terms.s8Body: Questions about these Terms can be sent to legal@zaltrix.app. We read every message and respond within five working days.
